dishes.name: Spreewald gherkins
dishes.desc: Pickled cucumbers with protected origin, grown and processed in the Spreewald. Eaten at stalls, from barrels and in salads.

dishes.name: Spreewald horseradish
dishes.desc: Sharp grated horseradish from the Spreewald, served with fish, sausage or meat. Part of the region's food tradition.

dishes.name: Plinse
dishes.desc: Yeast pancake of Sorbian-Wendish origin, baked thick and served with sugar, cinnamon and apple sauce.

dishes.name: Fürst-Pückler-Eis
dishes.desc: Layered ice cream of chocolate, strawberry and vanilla, named for the Cottbus park creator Prince Pückler. Sold in local cafés.

dishes.name: Spreewald eel
dishes.desc: Smoked or fried eel from the Spreewald waterways, a traditional local fish dish.
